meaning_en: to tip over / dump filled water bucket to cycle automaton

past.ar: كَبَّ القَادُوسُ مَاءَهُ حِينَ امْتَلَأَ جَوْفُهُ
past.de: Der Becher kippte sein Wasser, sobald er voll war
past.en: The bucket tipped its water once its cavity filled

present.de: Das Becken kippt die Flüssigkeit, um das Gewicht zu heben
present.en: The basin dumps the fluid to raise the counterweight

imperative.ar: كُبَّ بِمَيْعَةٍ تُعِيدُ الدَّوْرَةَ كُلَّ سَاعَةٍ
imperative.de: Kippe im Takt, der den Stundengang erneuert!
imperative.en: Tip in rhythm that restarts the hourly cycle!
